description: Use this when you need one inbox's address, display name, metadata, status, or client_id and you already have its id, username, or email. Read-only; requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (required; inbox id, username, or email). Returns the inbox {id, username, email, display_name, created_at, require_sender_auth, labels, expires_at, status, paused_at, metadata, client_id}. Another account's inbox returns HTTP 404 inbox_not_found.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address owned by this key

name: cooper_get_inbox
title: Get one inbox
